data.name: Modhu
data.gender_notes: Modhu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Modhu is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'madh', meaning delight or pleasure. In Hindu mythology, Modhu is an epithet of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Modhu carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Modhu usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Modhu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
